message: The other day, as I was sorting through my emergency supplies, I came across the extra battery packs I had stashed away. My grandkids rolled their eyes when I insisted on getting them last year, but when the power flickered during that surprise storm, I couldn't help but feel a little smug. We had light while others were digging around in the dark. It's funny how a little prep can turn a minor inconvenience into a cozy family night. Anyone else have a 'smug' moment like that?
